steps: Complete a sale of $120.00 paid fully with a Visa credit card (note last 4 digits)
Start a refund on the POS and scan the original receipt
Select all items and complete the refund
expectedResult: Refund of $120.00 is issued to the same Visa card (last 4 digits match the sale); no option to choose another tender is shown

steps: Complete a sale of $45.00 paid with cash
Start a refund using the original receipt and complete it
expectedResult: Refund of $45.00 is issued as cash and the cash drawer opens

steps: Complete a sale of $80.00 paid with a Mastercard
Start a refund for the transaction
Attempt to change the refund tender to cash or a different card
expectedResult: POS does not allow a tender different from the original; refund can only go to the original Mastercard

steps: Start a refund on the POS
Enter a transaction ID that does not exist
expectedResult: POS shows 'Original transaction not found'; no refund is processed and no SAP message is sent

steps: Use a sale with a purchase date 15 days before today
Start a refund for the sale and complete it
expectedResult: Refund is allowed and completes successfully

steps: Complete a sale today
Start a refund for the same sale on the same day
expectedResult: Refund is allowed (day 0 is inside the 30-day window)

steps: Use a sale with a purchase date exactly 30 days before today
Start a refund for the sale
expectedResult: Refund is allowed (day 30 is inside the window)

steps: Use a sale with a purchase date exactly 31 days before today
Start a refund for the sale
expectedResult: Refund is blocked with a message that the 30-day refund window has passed; no SAP message is sent

steps: Use a sale with a purchase date 60 days before today
Start a refund for the sale
expectedResult: Refund is blocked with a clear error message; transaction state is unchanged

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale paid in this order: $50.00 gift card, then $150.00 Visa
Start a full refund of $200.00 for the sale
expectedResult: Refund is applied in reverse order: $150.00 to the Visa first, then $50.00 to the gift card

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale paid in this order: $50.00 gift card, then $150.00 Visa
Refund one line item worth $100.00
expectedResult: Entire $100.00 goes to the Visa (last tender paid); gift card is not credited

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale paid in this order: $50.00 gift card, then $150.00 Visa
Refund line items totaling $160.00
expectedResult: $150.00 goes to the Visa (fully used up) and the remaining $10.00 goes to the gift card

steps: Complete a $300.00 sale paid in this order: $100.00 cash, $100.00 gift card, $100.00 Mastercard
Start a full refund of $300.00
expectedResult: Refund order is Mastercard $100.00, then gift card $100.00, then cash $100.00

steps: Complete a sale with 3 line items ($40.00, $60.00, $100.00) paid by Visa
Refund only the $60.00 line item
expectedResult: Refund of $60.00 is processed; the other 2 items remain refundable

steps: Complete a sale with 3 line items ($40.00, $60.00, $100.00) paid by Visa
Refund each line item in 3 separate refunds
expectedResult: All 3 refunds succeed; total refunded equals exactly $200.00, the original amount

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale and fully refund it
Start another refund on the same original transaction
expectedResult: POS blocks the refund with a message that the transaction is already fully refunded

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale and refund $150.00 of it
Attempt a manual-amount refund of $50.01 on the same transaction
expectedResult: Refund is blocked because it would exceed the original amount by $0.01; $50.00 is shown as the maximum remaining

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale
Attempt a manual-amount refund of $250.00 on the transaction
expectedResult: Refund is blocked; amount cannot exceed the original $200.00

steps: Complete a $500.00 sale
Start a full refund of $500.00
expectedResult: Refund completes without a manager approval prompt ($500.00 is not over $500)

steps: Complete a $500.01 sale
Start a full refund of $500.01
expectedResult: POS prompts for manager approval before the refund can complete

steps: Complete a $750.00 sale
Start a full refund
Manager enters valid credentials and approves
expectedResult: Refund completes; manager ID is recorded on the refund transaction

steps: Complete a $750.00 sale
Start a full refund
Manager declines the approval
expectedResult: Refund is cancelled; no money is returned and no SAP message is sent

steps: Complete a $750.00 sale
Start a full refund
At the approval prompt, enter credentials of a non-manager (cashier) user
expectedResult: Approval is rejected with an 'insufficient permissions' message; refund does not complete

steps: Complete a $90.00 sale paid by a Visa card
Mark the Visa card as expired in the test environment
Start a full refund
expectedResult: Refund of $90.00 is issued as store credit; customer receives store credit details

steps: Complete a $90.00 sale paid by a debit card
Mark the card account as closed in the test environment
Start a full refund
expectedResult: Refund of $90.00 is issued as store credit

steps: Complete a $90.00 sale paid by an active Visa card
Start a full refund
expectedResult: Refund goes to the original Visa; store credit is NOT issued

steps: Complete a $200.00 sale paid in this order: $50.00 gift card, then $150.00 Visa
Mark the Visa card as expired
Start a full refund
expectedResult: $150.00 Visa portion is issued as store credit, then $50.00 goes back to the gift card

steps: Complete a $120.00 Visa sale at store S001 and note the transaction ID
Process a full refund and note the refundId and refund time
Query SAP for the refund message
expectedResult: SAP has 1 message within 5 minutes containing refundId, originalTxnId, amount=120.00, tenderType=VISA, storeId=S001 and timestamp, all matching POS values

steps: Process a refund and record the POS refund completion time
Record the time SAP receives the message
expectedResult: Difference between POS refund time and SAP receipt time is 5 minutes (300 seconds) or less

steps: Process a refund that is issued as store credit (expired card scenario)
Check the SAP refund message
expectedResult: tenderType in the SAP message is STORE_CREDIT, not the original card type

steps: Refund a split-tender sale ($50.00 gift card + $150.00 Visa)
Check the SAP refund message(s)
expectedResult: SAP data shows both tenders with correct amounts ($150.00 VISA, $50.00 GIFT_CARD) and same originalTxnId

steps: Process a card refund
Inspect the raw SAP refund message payload
expectedResult: No mandatory field is null or empty, and no full card number appears in the message

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail the first send attempt, then succeed
Process a refund
expectedResult: POS retries once and SAP receives exactly 1 message (no duplicate); no error log entry is written

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail the first send and the first 2 retries, then succeed on the 3rd retry
Process a refund
expectedResult: Message is delivered on the 3rd retry; no error log entry is written

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail all send attempts
Process a refund
Count send attempts in POS logs
expectedResult: POS makes 1 initial send plus exactly 3 retries (4 attempts total), then stops; no 5th attempt is made

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail all send attempts
Process a refund
Check the POS error log after the 3rd retry fails
expectedResult: One error log entry is written containing refundId, originalTxnId, failure reason and timestamp

steps: Make SAP unreachable (network down)
Process a refund at the register
expectedResult: Customer refund still completes at the register; SAP failure is handled only through retries and the error log
